tools.name: register_free_key
tools.description:
Register a free API key with starter credits. One per agent; paid
    top-ups available from the operator.

tools.name: scan_token
tools.description:
Full safety scan of one Solana token mint: rug-pull risk score (0-100),
    verdict, mint/freeze authority, holder concentration, liquidity, pair
    age. Costs 1 credit. ALWAYS scan before buying a token.

tools.name: scan_tokens
tools.description: Bulk scan up to 20 token mints. Costs 1 credit per token.

tools.name: trending_tokens
tools.description:
Latest boosted/trending Solana tokens on DexScreener. Costs 1 credit.
    Tip: scan_token any candidate before trading.

tools.name: check_credits
tools.description: Check remaining credits for an API key.

tools.name: admin_stats
tools.description: OWNER ONLY: business overview — customers, calls, credits, plans.

tools.name: add_credits
tools.description: OWNER ONLY: add credits to a customer's key after payment is received.
